simple.summary: אֶלְדָּד (ʼEldâd) means Eldad , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Num 11 26.

definitions.full: H419. Eldad אֶלְדָּד proper name, masculine ( God has loved , compare Sabean ורראל DHM ZMG 1883. 15 ; see also יְדִידְיָה ) one of the elders Num 11:26-27 , probably = אֱלִידָד 34:21 where called a prince of Benjamin. — On proper names with אֵל compare those with אָב & אָח , & especially Nö l.c. ,, & (Sabean) DHM Epigr. Denkm. 88 .
